notes.title: 1.3 patch
notes.notes:
We're always checking the play of our users 
and trying to make sure they enjoy the game

1. Fix small bugs
- We stopped from going into the 10th floor

2. a reorganization of convenience
- We removed the noise heard while playing
- A guide has been added to the play button
- Change the name from Challenge Mode to Infinite Mode

3. Optimization
- It can be played more smoothly by optimizing graphics
